snippet.title: DRIFTERS: Blackout Crew - Announcement - All Platforms
snippet.description:
Announcing DRIFTERS: Blackout Crew, a PvE co-op VR extraction shooter built around tactile VR gunplay.

Raid ancient alien temples with up to four players, steal energy for your dying mothership, scavenge rare resources, and decide when to push deeper or extract. Back on the ship, turn loot into weapon parts, suit upgrades, and new tools for the next drop. 

🛒 Wishlist on Meta Quest: https://www.meta.com/experiences/quest/25178928995113487/
🛒 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4701660/DRIFTERS_Blackout_Crew/
💬 Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/salmigames

DRIFTERS is still in active development, and we’ll be shaping it closely with our community through playtests over the coming weeks and months. If you want to help us improve the game, join our Discord and sign up for playtests there.
